brief:
Mohammed Mokhber, an adviser to Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei, characterized threats of war from US President Donald Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as signs of "psychological warfare" and "desperation," Middle East Eye reported. Mokhber did not elaborate on specific threats or Iranian responses.

The comments come amid escalating rhetoric between Iran and the US-Israel alliance, though the aide offered no details on how Tehran plans to respond to the threats he described.

title: Iran's supreme leader aide dismisses Trump and Netanyahu threats as desperation
